en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Asbaat who said,

‘I said to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man implied to your<sup>asws</sup> brother Ibrahim and mentioned to him that your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) is alive and you<sup>asws</sup> know of that what he knows’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> passes away and Musa<sup>asws</sup> does not pass away? By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He<sup>asws</sup> has passed away just as Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> has passed away, but Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High, since He<sup>azwj</sup> Captured (the soul of) His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, did not cease to Come forward with this Religion upon the children of the non-Arabs, and Exchanging it away from the relatives of His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and so on. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Gave these ones and Prevented those ones.

I<sup>asws</sup> have paid off on his (Ibrahim’s) behalf during the crescent of Zilhajj, a thousand Dinars after he had decided to divorce his wife and free his slaves, but you have heard what Yusuf<sup>as</sup> faced from his<sup>as</sup> brothers’.
